Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Class PassiveItem

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Item
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.PassiveItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
BuildModifier
Direct Known Subclasses:
ExecutionerRing, FireRing, LifeStealRing, StatRing
public abstract class PassiveItem extends Item implements BuildModifier
A permanent modifier the player holds, such as the fire ring (GDD 1.3.1, 1.4). It changes the holder's build: its stats, its attack, or both.

Pattern: Decorator. Each passive wraps the stats or the attack it is given; the build applies them in pickup order, so removing one and rebuilding restores the holder exactly.

  • Constructor Details

    • PassiveItem

      protected PassiveItem(String id, String nameKey, String spriteId, int price)
      Creates a passive item. Every passive has the Rarity.PASSIVE rarity, so loot tables can pick passives by that tier.
      Parameters:
      id - the item's key in the data files
      nameKey - the translation key of its name
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it
      price - its shop price in coins; 0 means free
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a text is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a text is blank or the price is negative
